name: PlexPosterUpdater
description: Update your bad Plex Movie posters with this easy to use (hopefully) tool

ports.name: WEB PORT
ports.description: Web Port for your application, mine defaulted to 5000

variables.name: Plex URL
variables.description: The required plex port. Add the :32400 at the end

variables.name: PLEX TOKEN
variables.description: Your Plex token, you can get this from the plex web application

variables.name: TMDB API
variables.description: You need to sign up to TMDB (https://www.themoviedb.org) and get your api key.

variables.name: PLEX LIBRARY
variables.description: This is what your movie library in plex is called. Either Films, or Movies or whatever.

variables.name: Time Range
variables.description: Default value which the application starts with, leave unchanged.
